prompt: Complete a static paint method that draws a sideways histogram: a black axis down the left edge and one blue bar per value growing to the right. Follow the formulas in the starter Javadoc exactly.
explanation: Scaling each bar by values[i] * plotWidth / max means the largest value always fills the plotting area exactly, whatever the numbers are. Multiplying before dividing keeps the integer arithmetic accurate; dividing first would round most bars down to zero. Insetting each bar by two pixels top and bottom leaves a visible gap between rows without any extra drawing.
hints: Find max with a loop over values before you draw any bars.
The plotting area is width - AXIS pixels wide, and bars start at x = AXIS.
In barLength = values[i] * (width - AXIS) / max the multiplication must happen before the division, otherwise integer division truncates to 0.
